summary:
## Summary

Root cause of the broken refresh flow: the refresh cookie was set with `samesite="lax"`. The SPA (`http://localhost:5173`) and this API (`http://localhost:5199`, confirmed via `/tmp/sage-refs/life-cycle-frontend/.env.example`) are different origins, and `SameSite=Lax` cookies are never sent on a cross-site `fetch` `POST` (only on top-level GET navigations). So `POST /auth/login` worked (the access token comes back in the response body), but every subsequent `POST /auth/refresh` silently dropped the httpOnly cookie and 401'd with "missing refresh token" — matching the reported symptom exactly.

Fix, scoped to `app/config.py` and `app/routers/auth.py`:
- Added `refresh_cookie_samesite` (env `REFRESH_COOKIE_SAMESITE`, default `"none"`) and switched `refresh_cookie_secure`'s default to `true` (`SameSite=None` is rejected by browsers outright without `Secure`; Chrome/Firefox treat `localhost` as secure even over http, so local dev still works).
- `set_cookie` in `login`/`refresh`/`change-password` now uses `settings.refresh_cookie_samesite`.
- `logout`'s `delete_cookie` now passes matching `secure`/`samesite` attributes — otherwise the browser doesn't recognize it as clearing the same cookie.
- Updated `tests/conftest.py`'s two `TestClient` fixtures to use an `https://` base URL, since httpx's cookie jar (unlike a real browser) only resends `Secure` cookies over an https-scheme test transport.

Automatic access-token renewal itself (the retry-after-401 logic) already lives in the frontend's `http.js`/`authStore.js`, which is out of scope for this repo — the backend's job is to make `/auth/refresh` actually succeed, which it now does.

Verified: `python -m compileall app tests` and the full `pytest -q` suite (538 tests, including the auth flow's login → refresh-rotates → old-cookie-401 → logout → refresh-401 assertions) pass. Live `uvicorn` smoke testing wasn't possible — this sandbox blocks binding a listening port/process in Bash — so verification relied on the TestClient-based integration tests instead.
blockers: Not applied -- Automatic access-token renewal on expiry (retry-after-401 interceptor): already implemented in the frontend repo (services/http.js/authStore.js), which is out of scope here; backend only needed to make /auth/refresh actually succeed

endpoints.purpose: authenticate user, set httpOnly refresh cookie, return access token + user
exchange httpOnly refresh cookie for a new access token, rotates the cookie
revoke refresh token and clear the cookie (204 No Content)
get the current signed-in user from the bearer access token
change the signed-in user's password (204 No Content), rotates refresh cookie

context_sharing.notes: Auth router is registered twice in app/main.py: once bare (paths exactly /auth/login, /auth/refresh, /auth/logout, /auth/me, /auth/change-password) and once with prefix=/api/v1 (so also reachable at /api/v1/auth/*). Both id and tenantId in AuthUserResponse are UUID types on the wire (serialize as strings), matching the counterpart's expected 'string' type. Refresh token lives only in an httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=None cookie named settings.refresh_cookie_name (default 'refreshToken'); access token is a signed JWT returned in the body. change-password and refresh both rotate/reset the refresh cookie. login/me/change-password/logout/refresh all match the counterpart-requested paths exactly; none are missing. Error body shape ({error, details}) was not present in these three files and could not be verified here.
